title: Lument CEO James Flynn Elected Chair of Fannie Mae Multifamily DUS Advisory Council
summary: Lument CEO James Flynn was elected char of Fannie Mae's DUS Advisory Council.
body_markdown:
**New York, NY — Sept. 1, 2026 —** Lument announced today that CEO James Flynn has been elected to serve as the chair of Fannie Mae’s Delegated Underwriting and Servicing (DUS) Advisory Council. Composed of 10 senior leaders from the nation’s largest multifamily servicers, the council plays a vital role in helping Fannie Mae shape policy by sharing market insights and borrower feedback on its programs. Flynn served as vice chair of the council for the past two years.


“I am honored to have been elected to this post by my counterparts in the industry,” Flynn said. “The seriousness with which Fannie Mae considers the council’s observations and recommendations is a testament to the agency’s commitment to addressing the nation’s housing needs.”


As a leader in delivering Fannie Mae loans to clients across the U.S., Lument is closely connected to borrowers’ needs and concerns. The company is constantly looking for ways to improve the programs and the borrower experience.


“I look forward to continuing to partner with Fannie Mae to ensure the DUS platform serves the important needs of borrowers and to create and preserve quality housing as market conditions evolve,” Flynn added.


**About Lument**
Lument, a subsidiary of ORIX Corporation USA, is a national leader in commercial real estate finance and delivers a comprehensive set of capital solutions customized for investors in multifamily, affordable housing, and seniors housing and healthcare real estate. Lument offers Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, USDA, and balance sheet financing, as well as a full suite of capital markets lending products. In addition, Lument provides a suite of real estate advisory solutions including real estate investment sales, investment banking, and investment management solutions. The company has approximately 550 employees in over 30 offices across the United States.


Securities, investment banking, and advisory services are provided through Lument Securities, LLC, member FINRA/SIPC. Lument Investment Management, LLC, is registered as an investment adviser with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. For more information, visit www.lument.com.
